narrative: Markets are reacting to a projected Democratic sweep of both the House and Senate in the 2026 midterms, creating a 'Blue Wave' scenario that surprised investors. This political shift has triggered an initial risk-off move as traders anticipate legislative gridlock and increased regulatory oversight of the healthcare, energy, and finance sectors. Concerns are mounting over the future of AI data center expansion due to potential power grid prioritization by new Democratic governors. Additionally, voter backlash against the costs of the ongoing Iran war and high gasoline prices influenced the results, leading to a flight-to-safety in bonds and gold while the US dollar weakened.

Nasdaq.why: Futures dropped as much as 2% on concerns regarding tech regulation and potential pauses in AI data center construction due to power grid stability concerns (David Ingles).

S&P 500.why: Futures remained down approximately 0.74% as traders braced for political gridlock between the new Democratic Congress and the Trump administration (anchors).

Gold.why: Prices rose 0.45% as investors sought a flight to safety following the unexpected scale of the election results (David Ingles).

Oil.why: This asset was not covered in the provided notes.
